evidence_role: post-reveal prespecified frozen-model descriptive; not prospective, blinded, or confirmatory

scnet.description: protocol-matched independent reimplementation under a study-specific training recipe
scnet.inference: CUDA autocast float16, deterministic single view, no TTA
scnet.checkpoint_selection: best inner macro-F1, no outer-label selection

gate.dataset: stored HAM10000 outer-fold images in original order
gate.comparison: regenerated fold softmax against corresponding stored ScNet OOF probabilities
gate.failure_action: STOP W4; no external inference; no tolerance changes

inference_stage_A.prerequisite: gate PASS and binary/manifest hash verification
inference_stage_A.per_image: five individual fold softmax probability vectors
inference_stage_A.primary: arithmetic mean of five softmax probability vectors

scoring_stage_B.Derm7pt: 987 shared-six cases; 7-output argmax; akiec prediction is error; no six-class renormalization
scoring_stage_B.BCN: primary image-level, secondary lesion-level mean probabilities
secondary: five individual fold results and range
scoring_stage_B.bootstrap: paired case resampling Derm7pt; lesion-cluster resampling BCN; independent HAM lesion and Derm7pt case resampling for difference-in-degradation
scoring_stage_B.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals; report supports and denominators
scoring_stage_B.internal_reference: use validated harmonized shared-six internal predictions, do not infer missing class mapping

calibration: No external calibration, threshold tuning, or recalibration; ECE/NLL/Brier cross-system comparison deferred to W5/M6 development-only matched calibration
prohibitions: no model/recipe changes based on external labels
no use of historically exposed HAM as untouched
no claim of faithful published ScNet reproduction
execution_requirements: stored HAM ScNet OOF probabilities and fold/image manifest
frozen Derm7pt and BCN ordered image manifests and image bytes
source notebook implementation and package versions
